changelog: - **Super admin is per world, and internship-only surfaces are closed for a MARKETING org** (tenant isolation, WP7/WP8). `src/lib/superAdmin.ts` gains `superAdminWorld(session)` and `isSuperAdminFor(session, targetOrgId)` (pure rule in `src/lib/superAdminWorld.ts`, unit-tested): the flag, `isActive` and the caller's org are read live, the world is the caller's org's vertical, and the power is inert on the other world's host. `GET /api/admin/organizations` lists only the caller's world (`world`, and `verticals` = what it may create); `POST` requires an explicit `vertical` of that world (`400 vertical_required`, `403 vertical_other_world`); `PATCH` treats another world's org like a foreign tenant and refuses any cross-world vertical move (`403 vertical_other_world`); `invite-admin` answers another world's org with the same 404 as a missing id; `pipeline-stages`, `sso-exempt` and document requirements use `isSuperAdminFor`; the mail log shows only mail to addresses with an account in the caller's world (the 24h relay quota stays installation-wide). New operator CLI `prisma/set-super-admin.mjs --email … --world INTERNSHIP|MARKETING [--revoke] [--confirm] | --list` (dry run by default, idempotent, touches only that world's account). Capability gating: the newsletter (`/admin/newsletters`, `/newsletters`), `/admin/email` and `/admin/re-engagement` are tagged `mentorship` in `navLinks.ts`; every capability-tagged destination now answers `notFound()` at its URL through a one-line segment `layout.tsx` calling `gatePage()` (`src/lib/pageCapabilityGate.ts`, rule `src/lib/navRouteCapability.ts`, ratchet in `scripts/test/nav-route-capability.test.mjs`); `api/admin/newsletters/**`, `api/newsletters`, `api/admin/testimonials` and `api/admin/mentorship-requests` refuse with `403 capability_unavailable`, and the last two also filter by tenant by hand and 404 a foreign id. The organizations form now requires the vertical. Docs: `docs/worlds.md` § Süper-admin dünya başınadır / § Yalnız-internship yüzeyleri, `docs/role-access-matrix.md`.

en: Each product now has its own super admin: the internship and the marketing operator see and manage only their own product's organizations, and a new organization is always created with its product chosen explicitly. Internship-only screens — the newsletter, e-mail to mentees, re-engagement, testimonials — no longer open for a marketing organization, not even by typing their address.
tr: Her ürünün artık kendi süper yöneticisi var: internship ve marketing operatörü yalnızca kendi ürünlerinin organizasyonlarını görür ve yönetir; yeni bir organizasyon her zaman ürünü açıkça seçilerek oluşturulur. Yalnızca internship'e ait ekranlar — bülten, mentilere e-posta, yeniden kazanım, başarı hikâyeleri — bir marketing organizasyonunda artık açılmıyor, adresi doğrudan yazıldığında bile.
de: Jedes Produkt hat jetzt einen eigenen Super-Admin: Die Betreiber von Internship und Marketing sehen und verwalten nur die Organisationen ihres eigenen Produkts, und eine neue Organisation wird immer mit ausdrücklich gewähltem Produkt angelegt. Reine Internship-Seiten — Newsletter, E-Mail an Mentees, Reaktivierung, Erfolgsgeschichten — öffnen sich für eine Marketing-Organisation nicht mehr, auch nicht über die direkte Adresse.
